nodes.label: Version Bump on Merge / Push Workflow
nodes.rationale: Fires on push to main as well as merged PRs because this project commits straight to main, so a PR-only trigger would never fire. It auto-increments the patch and records a What's New entry; major and minor stay manual.

nodes.label: Bot Commit Loop Guard
nodes.rationale: The release commit carries [skip ci], which already stops GitHub from re-triggering; the github-actions[bot] author guard is belt-and-braces so the workflow can never loop.

nodes.label: Serialised Runs and Rebase Before Push
nodes.rationale: A version-bump concurrency group with cancel-in-progress false stops two quick pushes racing on the version files, and `git pull --rebase origin main` before pushing stops the push being rejected as non-fast-forward under rapid direct commits.

nodes.label: scripts/bump-version.mjs
nodes.rationale: Invoked as `node scripts/bump-version.mjs patch "$NOTE"`, where NOTE is the merged PR title or the first line of the pushed commit message; it writes src/data/version.json, src/data/whats-new.json and package.json.
